## A3. Burn-in

Twenty pilot D runs under the moment rule (Laplace α ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.3}, t₃ α = 0.3, main block, power law, five seeds) extended to T = 16,000 (C40): means over periods 11,000–16,000 against the pilot window 8,000–11,000, 95% CI across replications, and the OLS trend over 8,000–16,000. The 8,000-period burn-in stands if every headline series is within 2%. Each run reproduces its pilot D result up to period 11,000. The same check under the loggain rule (C33, pilot C) is in diagnostics/burn_in_c33_ext.md.

## A7b. The exact replay without its first-order term: the cv rule (C39)

decision_rule = cv averages the exact replayed log gain minus its first-order term rτ α(Σⱼ cⱼτ uⱼτ − uᵢτ), which has expectation zero under every arrangement; it is exact in expectation and expands nothing. Left: the statistic on the A7 draws. Right: behaviour on the main power-law cells, 45 runs on the main cells' seeds, medians over five replications; paired differences on the seed.
